text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction inside the emphatic opening; not an independent lexical item
words.prose: The opening particle resumes the Lūṭ episode rather than starting a detached report. Because it is fused into the wa-la-qad launch, the continuation also carries emphasis: the crime and punishment are heard as the next certified escalation after the prior warning scene. Its payoff is the boundary movement, where rejected warning is carried forward into consequence without renaming the actors.

topics.headline: resumptive emphatic launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as a continued Lūṭ-scene escalation, not as a fresh topic.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction coheres with the wa-la-qad frame and the ayah boundary, preserving continuity while adding renewed assertion force.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle bound into the la-qad certification frame
words.prose: The particle supplies the emphatic force of the la-qad frame. Its local value is not a loose oath expansion but a bound certification before the crime verb: the narrative peak is asserted before the action is named. That makes the attempted violation enter as an irreversible, verified crossing point rather than a doubtful accusation.

topics.headline: bound la-qad certification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the report is made emphatically certain before the crime verb appears.
topics.reason: The lām is bound to qad in an oath-emphasis formula whose force scopes over the following event chain.

words.gloss_range: certification particle before a perfect verb; marks completed verified action rather than imminence
words.prose: The certification particle works with the following perfect verb, so the local force is completed verification rather than mere nearness. Before the first lexical verb arrives, the ayah has already framed the offense as established event evidence. This completes the opening stack: continuity, emphasis, and completed fact all precede the naming of the crime.

topics.headline: completed verified action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attempted solicitation is presented as verified completed fact, not rumor or intention.
topics.reason: Qad before a perfect verb selects taḥqīq of a completed action and closes the emphatic pre-verbal frame.

words.gloss_range: persistent solicitation or pressure directed at Lūṭ, with the guests expressed through a prepositional field rather than as direct object
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes seeking, willing, and gentle or repeated movement; local Form III with the ʿan frame selects pressured solicitation, not simple internal wanting
words.prose: This verb stages the crime as mediated pressure: the plural actors press Lūṭ directly, while the guests are the demanded field through the following prepositional phrase. Form III keeps the action contestive and repeated, so the act is more than wanting; it is sustained solicitation against resistance. The same construction recalls the Yūsuf solicitation passages (12:23, 12:25), but here the target relation changes: pressure is routed through a host toward his guests. The compact plural subject and singular object suffix make group pressure on one man visible inside the word, while the later taste command answers coerced approach with imposed experience.

topics.headline: person object and guest field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Lūṭ is the grammatical object while the guests are the issue sought through him.
topics.reason: The verb has a clitic object for Lūṭ and an ʿan complement for the guests, so grammar separates pressured person from demanded field.

topics.headline: Form III pressured solicitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word describes active coercive solicitation, not simple desire.
topics.reason: The broad r-w-d field includes wanting and seeking, but local Form III plus the ʿan construction narrows it to pressured solicitation against resistance.

topics.headline: collective action on one object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the group acting as one completed agent against one directly pressured figure.
topics.reason: The 3mp agreement and 3ms object suffix compress the acting group and Lūṭ into one verb form.

topics.headline: solicitation formula and response arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this pressure verb belongs to a recognizable illicit-solicitation pattern and is answered by forced experience.
topics.reason: The rāwada plus ʿan construction echoes 12:23 and 12:25, and the local root-pairing links the pressure act to punishment language later in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the field concerning the guests and, secondarily, separation from their protection
words.prose: The preposition is the hinge that makes the guests the matter at issue without making them the verb’s direct object. Its local range keeps both concern and separation alive: they pressure Lūṭ about his guests and try to pull him away from protecting them. Its scope stops at the guest phrase, so the punishment clause is not governed by it but follows as consequence.

topics.headline: prepositional guest field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small preposition preserves the difference between the pressured person and the threatened guests.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the guest phrase as the content field of solicitation and blocks a direct-object reading for the guests.

topics.headline: concern with separation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demand is both about the guests and aimed at detaching them from Lūṭ’s protection.
topics.reason: The ʿan range includes several relations; the local frame preserves concerning and separation but does not activate substitution.

words.gloss_range: Lūṭ’s guest relation: a collective singular, genitive under ʿan, defined by his possessive suffix
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on guesthood, visitation, and inclining toward another; local possession selects protected guesthood and dependency
words.prose: The noun makes the threatened people Lūṭ’s guests, not a neutral crowd. The possessive suffix and genitive case bind them to his protective domain while keeping them inside the prepositional field rather than as direct objects of the pressure verb. Its collective singular gathers multiple visitors into one hosted trust relation, and the root image of inclining makes that relation one of dependency. Because this rare guest root links honored visitation and endangered visitation scenes (51:24, 15:68), the word carries more than countable visitors: it carries the violation of hosted protection.

topics.headline: possessed protected guesthood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the crime attacks a host-protected relation, not merely unnamed visitors.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix resolves to Lūṭ and turns guesthood into a defined relation of custody and obligation.

topics.headline: genitive but threatened party
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the role mismatch: the guests are syntactically governed by the preposition but semantically threatened by the solicitation.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under ʿan, so the guests remain the field at issue while Lūṭ bears direct pressure.

topics.headline: collective singular dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices multiple guests compressed into one dependent class leaning toward one host.
topics.reason: The root image of inclining is locally narrowed by possession and collective singular form into protected guest dependency.

topics.headline: rare visitation field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare guest term links Lūṭ’s endangered guests with wider visitation narratives, including 51:24 and 15:68.
topics.reason: The rare root is concentrated in guest narratives and co-occurs with the solicitation verb in the Lūṭ crime pattern.

words.gloss_range: resultative particle linking the soliciting directly to divine effacement
words.prose: This particle turns the move from crime to punishment into immediate consequence. It is not a loose and: it pivots from their soliciting to Our effacing, changing agent and moral direction at the particle boundary. As the first of two repeated fa steps, it begins the audible chain that will move from physical punishment to direct command.

topics.headline: immediate causal pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine response follows as direct consequence with no narrative delay.
topics.reason: The first fa links the solicitation clause to the effacement clause as result and immediate sequence.

topics.headline: first step in double consequence chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first beat of a two-step consequence rhythm: so We effaced, so taste.
topics.reason: The two fa particles create parallel consequence steps, with word 7 beginning the movement from crime into divine response.

words.gloss_range: decisive first-person plural effacement of the eyes; stronger than ordinary blindness language
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes effacing traces, features, roads, writing, and eyes; local object selects physical eye-effacement
words.prose: The verb is the ayah’s central turn: the subject shifts from their collective action to divine We, and the perfect form presents the intervention as decisive. Its object is the eyes, so the action is not ordinary blindness but effacement of visible form and perceptual access. The qiraat intensive variant makes this same erasure heavier, while the local Form I still carries a decisive act. Cross-passage links with 36:66 and 10:88 keep the rare root in an erasure field, and the contrast with 54:11 makes divine control over openings and closures visible inside the surah.

topics.headline: decisive divine intervention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the abrupt agency shift from their act to divine first-person intervention.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural verb interrupts the previous plural human agency and answers it directly.

topics.headline: effacement not ordinary blindness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment erases the eye-organs’ form, not merely the ability to see.
topics.reason: The broad ṭ-m-s erasure field is locally narrowed by the direct object eyes into physical eye-effacement.

topics.headline: intensive variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a recognized variant intensifies the erasure without changing the local punishment target.
topics.reason: The intensive variant adds gemination and thoroughness, while the canonical local form remains decisive Form I effacement.

topics.headline: rare erasure echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare erasure verb belongs to a wider field of divine closure and obliteration, including 36:66 and 10:88, and contrasts with opening at 54:11.
topics.reason: The root appears in material, perceptual, and cosmic erasure contexts; the local ayah applies that field to the attackers’ eyes.

topics.headline: warning becomes enacted seizure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warned group of 54:36 becomes the punished group whose sight is seized in 54:37.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence tracks the same plural group from warning and dispute into first-person divine intervention.

words.gloss_range: their eyes as the direct object of effacement: plural apertures possessed by the punished group
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes eye, spring, aperture, source, and essence; local verb selects eyes while retaining aperture pressure
words.prose: The noun names the direct patient of effacement, so the punishment lands on their eyes rather than on vision as a detached abstraction. The possessive suffix keeps the same warned and offending group attached to the organs now erased. As a broken plural, the word distributes the act across multiple eye-apertures, and the wider root field of eyes and springs lets closure stand against flow. That makes the links to 36:66, 54:12, 55:50, and 76:6 more precise: openings can be sealed in punishment or made to flow in other scenes.

topics.headline: possessed direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group’s own organs are the direct object of the divine act.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative object of the effacement verb and carries a plural possessor suffix tied to the punished group.

topics.headline: plural eye-apertures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the punishment as distributed closure of concrete apertures, not generic loss of sight.
topics.reason: The wide ʿ-y-n field is locally narrowed to eyes by the effacement verb, while the aperture image remains rhetorically active.

topics.headline: sealed and flowing apertures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root’s aperture field moving between sealed eyes and flowing springs, including 54:12, 55:50, and 76:6.
topics.reason: The object participates in the rare ṭ-m-s plus eye construction, while surah and cross-passage parallels contrast closure with flow.

words.gloss_range: second resultative particle, moving from narrated effacement into direct imperative address
words.prose: The second fa branches from narrated blinding into direct speech. It does more than mark sequence: it makes the command to taste the result and explanation of what the effacement means. Together with the first fa, it creates a two-step chain: crime is answered by physical punishment, then by enforced consciousness of that punishment.

topics.headline: resultative direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the register hinge from third-person narrative into second-person verdict.
topics.reason: The second fa opens the direct-speech clause and marks the imperative as consequent on the blinding.

topics.headline: double-fa escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s tightening rhythm: so We effaced, so taste.
topics.reason: The second fa completes a parallel consequence structure with the first fa and escalates action into imperative experience.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative to taste or undergo punishment as direct experience
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers literal tasting and firsthand experience; local abstract objects select imposed experiential contact
words.prose: The imperative shifts the punished group from narrated they into directly addressed you. As a command, it is not an ordinary request; it performs verdict and threat by forcing the addressees into the role of experiencers. Because it follows the effacement of eyes, taste becomes the replacement channel of knowledge: they do not merely see punishment from a distance, they undergo it bodily. The verb also governs a coordinated object set, so both punishment and warnings are tasted inside a formula that returns in 54:39 and 54:48.

topics.headline: performative imperative address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the narrative collapses into direct address exactly when punishment is imposed.
topics.reason: The 2mp imperative recovers the punished group as addressee and functions as verdict rather than ordinary instruction.

topics.headline: bodily knowledge after sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices taste as imposed bodily knowledge, especially after sight has been erased.
topics.reason: The root can denote literal tasting or firsthand experience; the abstract punishment object selects experiential contact while preserving the bodily image.

topics.headline: coordinated punishment formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taste command governs a defined punishment-warning object set, not vague suffering.
topics.reason: The imperative takes explicit objects and belongs to the dominant taste-punishment formula, with recurrence in 54:39 and 54:48.

words.gloss_range: My punishment as a possessed abstract noun made the direct object of tasting
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes punishment and a sweetness background; local phrase selects punitive consequence while the taste command keeps the sensory contrast live
words.prose: The noun is the tasted object, so punishment becomes a defined thing encountered rather than a vague state of pain. The first-person possessive makes it My punishment, carrying divine ownership inside the word and pairing with the final possessive warning noun. The taste frame keeps the root’s sweetness background as a reversal: what should be palatable becomes the anti-sweet object of bodily experience. In the repeated formula, this noun links the blinding scene to 54:39 and to the punishment-warning pair seen at 54:16, while the nominal form avoids another finite punishing verb and makes consequence something consumed.

topics.headline: divine-owned tasted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is a possessed object of direct experience, not generic suffering.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the taste imperative and carries the first-person possessive suffix of the divine speaker.

topics.headline: sensory punishment and sweetness reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bitter reversal created when a punishment noun with sweetness background is made something to taste.
topics.reason: The root range includes sweetness and punishment, but the local taste-punishment formula selects punitive consequence while preserving sensory contrast.

topics.headline: abstract noun made consumable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns punishment into a noun-object to be undergone rather than narrating another punishing verb.
topics.reason: The abstract nominal form functions as the object of tasting and makes judgment grammatically consumable.

topics.headline: punishment-warning refrain pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this object belongs to the surah’s repeated punishment-warning formula, including 54:16 and 54:39.
topics.reason: The phrase recurs in 54:39 and mirrors the paired nouns at 54:16, while cadence and collocation bind punishment to warnings.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction making warnings a second object with punishment under the same taste command
words.prose: The conjunction gives the warning noun equal object rank with punishment under the taste command. Chronologically warnings came first, but coordination makes them simultaneous in the experience of consequence: punishment is tasted together with the warnings that had been rejected. The tiny connector also keeps the final noun inside the same direct-speech object phrase rather than letting it sound like an afterthought.

topics.headline: warnings co-tasted with punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that warnings are not merely remembered; they become a second tasted object with punishment.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two nouns under the same imperative, making neither noun a modifier of the other.

topics.headline: prior warning made present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that temporal sequence is compressed into one syntactic experience.
topics.reason: The conjunction pivots from the punishment object to the warning object and places prior notice on the same syntactic level as consequence.

words.gloss_range: My warnings as the coordinated second tasted object and the ayah-final closure term
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes warning, warning agents, and binding notice or vow; local phrase primarily selects warnings while retaining messenger and pledge pressure
words.prose: The final noun completes the paired object structure: warnings themselves become something tasted with punishment. Its first-person possession remains active even where pausal recitation can clip the final yāʾ, so the closing word still means My warnings in grammar and reference. The plural keeps warning acts primary while allowing warners and binding-notice pressure to remain audible; rejected messages, messengers, and pledged consequence converge. Because this word closes the ayah and recurs across the Surah 54 refrain pattern (54:16, 54:18, 54:21, 54:30, 54:37, 54:39), the scene lands not merely on punishment but on fulfilled warning.

topics.headline: second tasted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prior warnings become part of the punishment’s felt content.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated with punishment under the taste imperative and completes the direct-speech object set.

topics.headline: possessive survives pausal clipping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that My remains grammatically operative at the ayah’s end even when the pause can reduce its sound.
topics.reason: The pausal and qiraat evidence changes how explicit the final possessive sounds, but the possessive relation remains active.

topics.headline: warnings with warner and pledge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the primary warning sense still gathers messenger function and binding notice into the final noun.
topics.reason: The local formula selects warning acts, while the plural form and root range preserve warners and vow-like binding consequence as secondary pressure.

topics.headline: refrain-tail closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on warnings, folding this scene into Surah 54’s recurring warning-consequence refrain.
topics.reason: The final word completes the formula repeated at 54:39 and recurs across Surah 54 refrain points, giving closure weight to warning rather than punishment alone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from soliciting concerning the guest to obliterating their eyes.
baseline_models.mechanism: A contested attempt to bend another will away from a protected guest is answered by disabling the attackers' perceptual agency; the means used to locate and appropriate the guest-space is turned off.

activation_trace.role: Contested solicitation toward an act supplies the coercive pressure that opens the mechanism.
A person inclined into another's lodging supplies the protected relational object of that pressure.
Extinguishing sight supplies the counter-action that removes the assailants' targeting capacity.
The seeing organ localizes the reversal in the faculty by which the sought object was pursued.

changed_reading.before: The crowd solicits Lot concerning his guest and is then blinded.
changed_reading.after: The assault is a contest over will and protected access whose answer disables the attackers' own instrument of access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The move from obliterated eyes to the command to taste punishment and warnings.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah exchanges predatory sight for compulsory taste: once sight is extinguished, warning ceases to be avoidable information and becomes embodied knowledge of consequence.

activation_trace.role: Loss of visual light closes the attackers' chosen sensory channel.
Direct visual witnessing supplies the mode of knowing that is revoked.
Experiential testing supplies the replacement mode by which the warning becomes undeniable.
Painful punishment supplies the content forced into experience.
A warning meant to awaken caution supplies the prior knowledge now converted into felt verification.

changed_reading.before: The closing command is a punitive taunt after blindness.
changed_reading.after: The command names a sensory conversion: refused warning is made knowable through involuntary experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a repeated trajectory from rejecting warning, through disputing the announced seizure, to being taken for denial; this strengthens the focus sensory shift as forced verification rather than an isolated injury.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood to the warnings supplies the initial refusal of their truth.
Fear-awakening warning supplies the knowledge rejected before the focus event.
Overpowering seizure supplies the specific consequence announced immediately before the focus.
Contentious denial of truth supplies the active resistance that separates warning from acceptance.
Experiential testing is the focus hinge that converts resisted notice into knowledge.
A later recurrence of denial shows that the focus mechanism belongs to a repeated contextual pattern.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies the recurring terminal step of that pattern.

structural_cues: 54:33 opens the episode with rejection of warnings, and 54:36 places disputed warning of seizure directly before 54:37.
54:42 repeats denial followed by taking, extending the same sequence beyond the local episode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, disputed warning, embodied tasting, and later culpable taking; I infer an epistemic arrow from refused notice to forced verification. A live alternative is that these are parallel punishment formulas without a staged theory of knowing.

changed_reading.before: Tasting punishment follows the attackers' deed.
changed_reading.after: Tasting punishment completes a denial sequence by forcing verification of knowledge repeatedly refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding rescue extracts Lot's relational household by separation before dawn and names that outcome favor and recompense, while the focus disables those pressing into his guest relation; hospitality becomes a boundary across which opposite outcomes are sorted.

activation_trace.role: The people who return relationally to Lot supply the protected household unit.
Deliverance by separation supplies the outward movement of the protected group.
The pre-dawn interval supplies the timed opening through which separation occurs.
Beneficent good condition classifies the rescue side of the differential outcome.
Action answered by corresponding recompense supplies the sorting logic.
Recognition of favor supplies the responsive disposition associated with rescue.
The lodged guest supplies the relational threshold the attackers attempt to breach.
Extinguished sight supplies the inwardly directed outcome for those pressing across that threshold.

structural_cues: 54:34-35 place rescue and its evaluative explanation immediately before the warning and assault of 54:36-37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household extraction, favor, recompense, a threatened guest relation, and blinding; I infer that the guest boundary organizes the contrast between protected separation and blocked intrusion. The rescue and punishment could instead be merely adjacent outcomes without hospitality as their causal hinge.

changed_reading.before: The guest is the object over whom the confrontation occurs.
changed_reading.after: The guest relation marks a protective boundary that reveals and separates opposed moral trajectories.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah schedules a stable punishment at daybreak, so the focus blinding reads as nocturnal incapacitation and threshold event rather than necessarily the whole punishment.

activation_trace.role: Extinguishing sight supplies the immediate disabling event.
Arrival in the morning supplies the transition to a subsequent phase.
The beginning of day sharpens the temporal boundary after the focus event.
Painful punishment names what arrives across that dawn boundary.
Fixity and settlement distinguish the arriving punishment from the immediate disabling act.

structural_cues: 54:38 follows 54:37 directly and adds both an early-morning timestamp and the predicate of settled persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blinding followed by morning arrival of settled punishment; I infer a phase relation in which blinding incapacitates before the fuller event. A live alternative is that 54:38 redescribes the same punishment from a broader temporal angle.

changed_reading.before: The obliteration of eyes is the complete punitive endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The obliteration is an immediate incapacitating prelude at the edge of a settled dawn punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact taste-punishment-warning triad recurs after the morning punishment and is followed by facilitated recitation for remembrance; the focus close becomes a mnemonic refrain meant to carry warning beyond the scene.

activation_trace.role: Repeated experiential testing turns the focus command into a reusable interpretive seal.
Repeated painful consequence broadens the formula from the eye event to the settled punishment.
Repeated caution-awakening warning makes the formula portable beyond its first utterance.
Ease after difficulty supplies the accessibility of the warning's recited form.
Recitation supplies the transmissible medium in which the focus formula persists.
Recollection after or against forgetting supplies the intended alternative to compulsory tasting.

structural_cues: 54:39 duplicates the final three roots and wording of 54:37.
54:40 immediately follows that duplication with the recurring ease-and-remembrance question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition followed by facilitated recitation and recollection; I infer that the focus close functions as a mnemonic refrain, with remembered warning as the alternative to embodied verification. The ease-and-remembrance verse may also be a general surah refrain rather than a direct gloss on tasting.

changed_reading.before: The closing words are addressed only to the blinded attackers.
changed_reading.after: The closing words are also shaped as a repeatable warning unit designed to be recited and remembered by later hearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later boast of a mutually supporting collective is answered by a broken battle line and backs turned; against that pattern, the focus plural eyes are not only individual organs but a crowd's coordinated capacity to target and advance.

activation_trace.role: The scout or watch function lets the plural eyes carry a secondary collective-coordination role.
Voiced assertion supplies the collective's explicit claim about itself.
Joining dispersed persons into one body supplies the claimed coordinated force.
Mutual aid and manifested victory supply the confidence attached to that coordination.
Breaking and driving back a battle line supplies the reversal of collective coherence.
The repeated gathered body identifies what is broken.
Turning away supplies the loss of forward orientation after the line breaks.
Presenting the back supplies the visible endpoint of failed advance.

structural_cues: 54:44-45 place collective self-confidence and its reversal near the end of the packet window.
The focus uses plural eyes for a group acting together against one protected relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a coordinated group in the focus and a later boast-to-rout pattern; I infer that loss of eyes functionally prefigures loss of collective orientation. The later collective may be typologically analogous rather than identical to Lot's attackers.

changed_reading.before: Each assailant loses sight as an individual punishment.
changed_reading.after: The crowd also loses its shared targeting system, a local anticipation of boastful collectives being broken and turned back.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the punitive sense is primary in the clause, but the same focus root also carries restraint, prevention, and weaning, which mirrors the attempted coercion over the guest. Render only as secondary lexical irony, not as a replacement for painful punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The attackers seek access concerning the guest and are told to taste the speaker's punishment.

activation_trace.role: Coercive solicitation supplies the attempt to make another permit an act.
The lodged guest supplies what the assailants seek to reach.
Restraint and forced abstention supply an ironic functional underside to the named punishment.

changed_reading.before: Punishment inflicts pain after attempted coercion.
changed_reading.after: Punishment also mirrors the offense as forced abstention: those compelling access are themselves forcibly cut off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it activates the packet's alternate mapped root for the solicitation token and extends eyes to scouts and obliteration to route-loss. It remains anchored in three focus words and yields a coherent pursuit mechanism; render as an exploratory overlay beside literal solicitation and blindness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The solicitation, obliteration, and plural eyes can form a repeated search circuit that is disabled.

activation_trace.role: Repetition, back-and-forth movement, and hesitation supply an iterative pressure circuit in the split-root inventory.
Seeking and scouting for an object supplies the goal-directed side of that circuit.
A ruined place with no traversable route supplies the circuit's functional interruption.
The scout or watcher supplies the distributed search function that is erased.

changed_reading.before: One solicitation is answered by literal blindness.
changed_reading.after: An iterative reconnaissance-and-pressure loop is stopped by erasing both its scouts and usable approach.

strongest_changes: Denied warning becomes compulsory sensory verification: predatory sight is exchanged for punitive taste.
The following dawn and settled punishment recast the blinding as an immediate incapacitating phase.
Exact repetition in 54:39 and remembrance in 54:40 turn the focus close into a portable mnemonic refrain.
The later boast and rout expose a collective layer in the obliteration of plural eyes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses coercion, protected relation, sensory reversal, and warning into one causal chain; nearby repetition then scales that local event into memory and collective pattern without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the dawn punishment is a later phase or a broader redescription of the eye event.
Whether hospitality itself organizes the rescue-punishment contrast or only marks the immediate object of assault.
How much weight the split-root repetition image and scout/route overlay can bear in downstream prose.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Predatory solicitation is answered at the organ of predation.** `ر و د` B002 is soliciting another toward an act and B003 seeking/scouting; `ض ي ف` B002 is the guest who turns in; `ط م س` B002 is loss of light/sight and B001 erasing a trace; `ع ي ن` B001 is the seeing eye. The sequence moves from seeking access to the guest to erasure of the seekers’ eyes. The packet supplies offense and sensory consequence; I infer a measure-for-measure directional link. The ayah reads the blinding as disabling the very scouting capacity used in the approach.

2. **Taste converts warning from report into direct test.** `ذ و ق` B001 is literal tasting and B002 experiencing/testing; `ع ذ ب` B005 is torment and `ن ذ ر` B001 warning. The imperative follows loss of sight, shifting the sensory register from seeing to tasting. I infer that refused visual and verbal evidence returns as embodied experience. “Taste” remains figurative experience while retaining the immediacy of bodily contact.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 54:48 returns to `ذُوقُوا۟` and joins taste to touch while bodies are dragged on faces. That final sensory compression enlarges this local eye-to-taste reversal into a surah-wide movement from refused perception to unavoidable embodied knowledge.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`ر و د / B002` (soliciting another toward an act) with `ض ي ف / B003` (the side and what presses near from the sides).** Solicitation is given a spatial mechanism: the group pressures Lot around those who have turned in as guests. The packet supplies repeated solicitation and guest relation; I infer social pressure from the sides -> attempts to detach host from protected guest. **Reading change:** `رَاوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِ` is coercive encirclement, not a neutral request.
2. **`ط م س / B002` (loss of light and sight) with `ع ي ن / B002` (seeing face to face).** They seek improper access at close range; their eyes then lose the very capacity for face-to-face access. The packet supplies pressured proximity -> obliterated sight; I infer predatory seeing -> is reversed by removal of visual orientation. **Reading change:** `فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُم` is a targeted disabling of the offense's instrument.
3. **`ن ذ ر / B003` (wound with obligatory compensation) with `ذ و ق / B002` (experiencing and testing) and `ع ذ ب / B005` (punishment).** Bodily eye-loss immediately becomes an imperative to undergo the warned consequence. The packet supplies offense, bodily injury, and command to experience; I infer violated protection -> embodied requital. **Reading change:** warning crosses from contested speech into sensory verification.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 54:38-39 completed the sensory reversal by turning erased sight into settled and tasted consequence; 54:42 then showed the same notice-to-enforcement structure at household scale.

baseline.text: Konukları konusunda ona baskı yaptılar; biz de gözlerini kör ettik. Azabımı ve uyarılarımı tadın!

findings.text: Konuklara erişmek için kullanılan arayıcı bakış, gözlerin silinmesiyle hedefli biçimde etkisizleştirilir; sonuç suçun algı aracına yönelir.
Görsel ve sözlü kanıtı reddedenler için tatma buyruğu, uyarıyı uzaktan dinlenen sözden kaçınılamayan beden deneyimine çevirir.
Konuk kökündeki yanlardan yaklaşma çağrışımı, baskıyı Lût'u koruduğu kişilerden ayırmaya çalışan çevreleyici bir toplumsal sıkıştırma olarak gösterir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The concrete ritual frame clarifies what the surah's accusations presume: signs and messengers are classified as covert manipulations, even though the actual reversal of sight and agency arrives openly in judgment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An injurious gaze is countered or exploited by a binding charm that takes hold of the eye or will, while a facing bead turns one person toward another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: evil-eye affliction `quranic:root_001069:B004/m01`; binding spell or amulet `quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`; face-turning bead `quranic:root_001198:B016/m01`; magic as deceptive redirection `quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This object-and-operation scene materializes the manipulation alleged by `سحر`: a charm constrains attention and a bead redirects a face. The surah pressures that diagnosis because no concealed object compels the observers; they turn away from an exposed sign by their own response.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Animals are driven toward water at night, watered at the mouth in a drinking cohort, moved to nearby pasture, and brought back after ranging.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: night drive toward a watering place `quranic:root_001212:B008/m01`; drawing water at camels' mouths `quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`; drinking cohort or shared watering group `quranic:root_000783:B003/m01`; livestock circuit between water and pasture `quranic:root_001486:B006/m01`; ranging back and forth in pasture `quranic:root_000610:B004/m01`; evening return of livestock `quranic:root_000609:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The P2 drinking share belongs to a larger husbandry rhythm in which access, movement, and return are interdependent. Violating the attended turn therefore breaks more than a quota: it tears the communal circuit that converts water into continued life.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Whole-surah - Hide Converted into Portable Water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An animal hide becomes a reliable water vessel through removal, joining, fine stitching, seasoning, and leak control.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The craft materializes the difference between possessing water and controlling access to it: portable provision depends on carefully maintained boundaries, whereas the flood opens boundaries and the final rivers flow without scarcity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Water seasons the bag and seals its vulnerable eye
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The stitched bag is treated with clay and water to improve taste and close its seams; any thin spot or eye is tested by whether it leaks or seals when wetted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: portable water bag `quranic:root_001212:B009/m01`; seasoning and sealing a water bag with clay and water `quranic:root_000783:B013/m01`; leaking or sealable eye in a hide vessel `quranic:root_001069:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Water is both contents and test medium: it exposes a defective seam and helps close it. The mechanism sharpens the surah's water contrasts, where measured access requires maintained containment but judgmental water defeats every ordinary vessel.

concept_map.definition: Bir yone cikildiktan sonra geri donerek gidip gelmeyi veya yerler arasinda yinelenen bicimde dolasmayi anlatir. Bu hareket surunun otlakta ileri geri yayilmasinda, bir yere sik sik gidilmesinde, gidilip gelinen yerde ya da yatakta durulamamada gorulebilir.

facets.statement: Bir yere gidip geri gelerek yinelenen yer degistirme hareketidir.
Surunun otlakta one ve arkaya dogru dolasmasi bu hareketin bir gerceklesmesidir.
Gidilip gelinen yer, yinelenen hareketin gerceklestigi alan olarak adlandirilir.
Bir kadinin komsu evleri arasinda sikca dolasmasi bu goruntuyle anlatilir.
Yastikta bir turlu durulamayip donup durma, gidip gelme goruntusunun yataktaki karsiligidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, gidip gelme cekirdegini surunun otlakta ileri geri hareketi, gidilip gelinen yer, komsu evleri arasinda dolasma ve yastikta durulamama gibi somut gerceklesmelerle destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir yon ile geri donus arasinda yinelenen yer degistirmenin cekirdek oldugu butun genel kullanimlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hareketin gidis ve donuslu, yinelenen yapisini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canli bir varligin veya surunun belirli bir alanda yinelenen yon degisiklikleriyle dolastigi baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yinelenen gidis gelisi ve alan icindeki dolasma goruntusunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayni yerler, ozellikle evler arasinda yinelenen ziyaret veya gidis gelis baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yerler arasindaki yinelenen gidis ve donusu acikca verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisinin yastiginda veya yataginda bir turlu durulamadigi baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yerlesememe ve yinelenen hareket goruntusunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gidip gelmek ve ileri geri dolasmak
suru veya bakicinin gidip geldigi yer
kadinin komsu evleri arasinda sik sik dolasmasi

error_profile.preserves: Arama sirasinda gerceklesebilen dolasma hareketini sezdirir.
error_profile.loses: Arama amaci olmayan gidip gelme ve durulamama kullanimlarini disarida birakir.
error_profile.adds: Hareketin mutlaka bir seyi bulma amaci tasidigi varsayimini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Dolasarak arama dalinin cekirdegiyle karisir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sik gidilen yer ve yatakta durulamama gibi adlandirmalari da gidip gelme goruntusune baglar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, urken ya da dizginlenen hayvanin hareketini, zayif kipirdamayi ve hareket edebilme gucunu de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalin cekirdeginde ileri geri yer degistirme ve yinelenen hareket bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gidis ve geri donus yapisini somut yerler arasinda kurar; komsu dal ayni hareket goruntusunu hayvan tepkisi, zayif kipirdama ve hareket yetisi gibi daha genis durumlara yayar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kaygi ya da dengesizlik gerektirmeyen siradan gidip gelmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, asili nesnenin sallanmasini, iki secenek arasinda kalmayi ve tedirgin hareketi de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalin cekirdegi yalnizca gidis ve donustur; komsu dal bu hareketi sallanma, kararsizlik veya tedirginlik siniriyla belirler.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal, dalganin ya da ona benzetilen atin kabarip alcalanarak calkanmasina ozgudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ileri geri hareket ve yon degisimi goruntusunu tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yerler arasinda gidis ve geri donusu anlatir; komsu dal ise dalga benzeri kabarip alcalanma ve calkanma turundeki hareketi adlandirir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal, bir alanda yinelenen hareket ve yer degistirme icerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hareket biciminin kendisini adlandirir; komsu dal ayni hareketi bir seyi bulmaya yonelik arama gorevinin araci yapar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yuruyus ve eylemde yumusaklikla yavas ilerlemeyi, acele etmeme veya bekletme buyrugunu ve sert esmeyen ruzgar ornegini ayni sinir icinde verir. Hazirlanan dal bu yonu salt kararsiz hareketten ayirdigi icin kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yavaslik burada durgunluk degil, hareketin veya eylemin yumusak ve acele edilmeden yapilmasidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yumusak ve acele etmeden davranma cekirdegi, yuruyus, bekletme buyrugu ve sert esmeyen ruzgar yapilarinda ayri gerceklesmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hareketi veya isi sertlik ve acele olmadan, yumusak ve yavas bicimde yapmayi anlatir. Birine yavaslamasini ya da beklemesini soyleyen kullanimlarla sert esmeyen ruzgar nitelemesi bu cekirdege baglidir.

facets.statement: Hareketi veya isi yumusak, yavas ve acele etmeden yapmaktir.
Yuruyus ve yol almada hiz kesip yumusak ilerlemeyi anlatir.
Birine yavaslamasini, acele etmemesini veya beklemesini soyleyen buyruk olarak kullanilir.
Sert ve guclu esmeyen yumusak ruzgar bu niteligin dogadaki ornegidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, yuruyuste ve genel eylemde yumusak yavaslik, acele etmeme veya bekleme buyrugu ve siddetle esmeyen ruzgar ornegini tek bir yumusak ilerleme cekirdegine baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir hareketin ya da isin sertlikten ve aceleden uzak bicimde surduruldugu genel kullanimlar icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yavasligi, acele etmeyisi ve hareketin yumusak bicimini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yuruyus veya yol alma hizinin dusuk ve davranisin yumusak oldugu baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yol almanin yavas, acele etmeden ve yumusak yapilmasini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birine hizini dusurmesini veya yaptigi iste acele etmemesini soyleyen buyruklarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Karsi tarafa yoneltilen yavaslama ve aceleden kacinma buyrugunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ruzgarin sert ve guclu esmedigini belirten niteleme baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Ruzgarin siddetten uzak ve yumusak esisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, el degirmenini cevirmeye yarayan tutamak kolunu ve donerek calisan ince cubuk ya da demir parcalari ayni arac dalinda toplar. Hazirlanan cerceve, otlak arayan kisiyle ve goz kusuruyla yalnizca bicim ortakligi bulunan bu arac anlamlarini dogru ayirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir seyi elle cevirmeye veya donen duzenekte eksen gorevi gormeye yarayan somut arac adlariyla sinirlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sinif yalindir; tanim arac adlarinin dogrudan anlamini verir ve baska dallardaki soz dizisine bagli okumalar buraya tasinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesneyi elle cevirmeye yarayan tutamak kolunu veya bir duzenekte donerek calisan ince cubuk ve demir parcayi anlatir. El degirmeni kolu, gemde donen demir ve makaranin demir donme ekseni bu arac grubuna girer.

facets.statement: Bir seyi cevirmeye veya donen duzenekte calismaya yarayan somut aractir.
El degirmenini ceviren kisinin kavradigi tutamak kolunu adlandirir.
Ince cubugu, gemde donen demir parcayi veya makaranin demir donme eksenini adlandirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, el degirmenini cevirmek icin tutulan kol ile ince cubuk, gemde donen demir ve demir makara ekseni gibi donen arac parcalarini ayni somut arac alaninda birlestirir.

concept_gloss.text: cevirme kolu ve doner demir parca
concept_gloss.applicability: El degirmeni kolu ile donerek isleyen ince demir arac parcalarini birlikte gosteren dal basligi olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Elle ceviren tutamak ile duzenekte donen demir parca turlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Degirmeni ceviren kisinin eliyle kavrayip dondurdugu ahsap kol veya tutamak icin kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aracin kavranma, cevirme ve el degirmenine bagli olma ozelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gem veya makara icinde donen demir cubuk ya da donme ekseninin anlatildigi teknik baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Demir parcanin duzenek icinde donerek eksen gorevi gormesini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki kanitta da ayni goz soz dizisini ve gozde dolasan bir bozukluk anlamini verir. Hazirlanan dal bu anlami otlak arayan kisi ya da degirmen kolu gibi ayni bicimli adlardan ayirir ve yalnizca goz yapisina baglar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalniz gozle kurulan soz dizisinde gecerlidir; tek basina genel bir kusur veya kisi adi sayilamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalniz gozde dolasan bozuklugu adlandiran sabit soz dizisine baglidir ve bu anlam tek basina kullanilan bicime genellenmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, genc kiz ile genc ve guzel kadin adlandirmalarini acikca destekler. Bununla birlikte kucultmeli bir bicimin buyutulmus karsiligi olduguna iliskin not, tek basina genclik anlamini kurmaz; bu nedenle dal korunur ancak bu bicimsel bag anlam taniminin disinda tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadin icin genc, kimi bicimlerde de genc ve guzel olma nitelemesiyle sinirlidir; bicimsel buyutme notu ayri bir genclik anlami sayilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genc kiz nitelemesi belirli bir ad soz dizisinde, genc ve guzel kadin anlami ise ayri bir ad biciminde gerceklesir; biri digerinin sinirlarini genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kiz veya kadini genc diye niteleyen adlandirmadir. Ayri sesletisli ad bicimleri, genclige guzellik niteligini da ekleyerek genc ve guzel kadini anlatir.

facets.statement: Kiz veya kadin icin genc olma niteligini bildirir.
Belirli ad bicimlerinde genclik ile guzellik birlikte belirtilir.
Kucultmeli bir bicimin buyutulmus karsiligina iliskin aciklama bicimsel bagdir ve genclik tanimina yeni bir ozellik eklemez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, bir ad soz dizisinde genc kizi ve ayri sesletisli bicimlerde genc ve guzel kadini belirtir; ayrica anlam sinirini genisletmeyen bir bicim buyutme bagi kaydeder.

error_profile.preserves: Kadin cinsiyetini, gencligi ve belirli bicimde eklenen guzellik niteligini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadin kisinin yalnizca genc oldugunun belirtildigi ad soz dizisinde kullanilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hem bir şeyin ya da kişinin önceki yerine veya durumuna dönmesini hem de onun oraya döndürülmesini açıkça ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Görmenin yeniden kazanılması bu çekirdeğin bir durumun geri gelmesi biçimindeki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek dönüş ve geri döndürmedir; yalnızca engelleme, reddetme, ticari geri alma veya yineleme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dönüş çekirdeğini korur; yön bildiren, yetki devreden ve belirli bir durumun geri gelmesini anlatan yapılar ayrı özel kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin veya kişinin önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna dönmesi yahut bir etken tarafından oraya döndürülmesidir. Kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanılması da aynı geri gelme düzeninin özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Hareketin temel yönü, bir varlığın daha önce bulunduğu yere veya duruma geri gelmesidir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir etken, şeyi yerine, sahibine veya bağlı olduğu merciye geri gönderir.
Bir yetinin yeniden ortaya çıkması, önceki durumun geri kazanılması olarak kavranır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortaklaştırılmış anlatımı, kendiliğinden geri gelme ile bir şeyi geri gönderme biçimlerini tek dönüş çekirdeğinde birleştirir; yer, sahip, merci ve önceki işlev bu yönün farklı hedefleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna yöneldiği hem geçişsiz hem geçişli kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dönüş yönünü, önceki konumu veya durumu ve ettirgen geri gönderme seçeneğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Görme gibi kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanıldığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki durumun veya işlevin yeniden elde edilmesini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin sahibine veya ait olduğu yere gönderildiği geçişli bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi ait olduğu kişiye veya yere geri yöneltme ilişkisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yöneldiği taraftan çevirmeyi ve zarar, lütuf ya da ceza bağlamında onu savuşturup engellemeyi aynı uzaklaştırma işlevinde birleştirir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu yapıya bağlı anlamı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir şeyi bir yönden veya hedeften uzaklaştıran yapılara bağlıdır; yalın geri dönüş ve kabul etmeme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yön, hedef veya engelleme ilişkisini açıkça kuran yapılarda geçerlidir; yalın köke genel bir engelleme anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yöneldiği yol, hedef veya eylemden çevirerek uzaklaştırmak; böylece bir etkiyi, zararı ya da sonucu savuşturmak veya engellemektir.

facets.statement: Etkilenen varlık, yöneldiği yol veya işten başka tarafa çevrilir.
Bir etki ya da sonucun gerçekleşmesine engel olmak, onu hedeften uzaklaştırmanın özel biçimidir.
Çevirme sert bir savma biçiminde olabileceği gibi bir işten yumuşakça vazgeçirme biçiminde de gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, yönünden çevirme ile bir etkiyi önleme arasında işlevsel bağ kurar; savma, engelleme ve bir işten vazgeçirme aynı yapı içindeki farklı şiddet dereceleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın yolundan çevrildiği veya bir etkinin hedefe ulaşmasının önlendiği bağlı yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yön değiştirmeyi, uzaklaştırmayı ve bunun engelleyici sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin yöneldiği işten çevrildiği, özellikle yumuşak yönlendirmenin söz konusu olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yön değiştirme çekirdeği güçlü biçimde örtüşür; odak dalın zarar, iyilik ve cezanın engellenmesi kapsamı daha geniş olduğundan ilişki kısmi kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiyi bir işten yumuşakça çevirme ve engellenemez sonuç yapıları bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal düşmanı, cezayı veya ölümü savunma, kuşku ya da kanıt yoluyla uzaklaştırma bağlamlarını özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yaklaşan şeyi hedeften uzaklaştırma ve zararlı sonucu önleme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yön veya işten çeviren yapıya bağlıdır; komşu dal ise savunma ve zararı giderme bağlamlarını daha belirgin biçimde öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Burada amaç bir şeyi yolundan çevirmek veya etkisini önlemektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda belirleyici olan nesne, söz ya da paranın kabul edilmemesi veya yanlış sayılmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki durumda bir şey hedeflediği kabul veya sonuca ulaşamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal fiziksel ya da soyut yön değiştirme ve savuşturmayı anlatır; komşu dal ise değerlendirme sonucu kabul etmeme ve geçersiz sayma eylemini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; en yakın yön değiştirme komşuları ile kabul etmeme dalı arasındaki üç sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رد الشيء عن وجهه أو عن أمر، ودفع الضرر أو منعه، وما لا راد له بمعنى لا دافع ولا مانع
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الرجوع المجرد ولا رد الشيء لعدم قبوله إلا إذا كان المقصود دفعا أو صرفا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رده عن وجهه يرده ردا ومردا صرفه (sihah)؛ رده عن الأمر ولده أي صرفه عنه برفق (tahdhib)؛ لا راد لفضله أي لا دافع ولا مانع له وعذاب غير مردود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi kabul etmeme, sözü yanlış sayma ve sahte olduğu anlaşılan parayı geri çevirme kullanımlarını açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal çerçevesi, geri göndermeyi tek başına değil olumsuz değerlendirme sonucuna bağlı olarak sunar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirleyici unsur kabul etmeme veya geçersiz saymadır; yalnızca geri gönderme ya da zarar savuşturma yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, bir şeyi kişiye karşı geri çeviren veya sahte parayı geri veren yapılara bağlıdır; yalın kök için genel reddetme anlamı kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sunulan bir şeyi kabul etmeyip sahibine geri çevirmek veya bir söz ya da iddiayı yanlış ve geçersiz saymaktır. Daha önce alınmış sahte paranın denetleyene geri verilmesi bu değerlendirmenin somut ticari örneğidir.

facets.statement: Nesne, söz veya iddia olumsuz değerlendirme sonucunda kabul edilmez.
Bir sözü yanlış saymak, kabul etmemenin doğruluk değerlendirmesine uygulanmış biçimidir.
Sahte olduğu belirlenen paranın onu denetleyene geri verilmesi, kabul etmemenin ticari örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortaklaştırılmış ifade, reddetme eylemini kabul ve doğruluk değerlendirmesine bağlar; sahte paranın geri çevrilmesi bu çekirdeğin nesnel bir denetim sonucunda gerçekleşen örneğidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesne, söz veya iddianın olumsuz değerlendirilerek reddedildiği yapıya bağlı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sahtecilik değerlendirmesini ve paranın geri çevrilmesini birlikte korur.

branches.branch_image_ar: عدم القبول ورد الزائف أو الخطأ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رد الشيء إذا لم يقبل، وتخطئة القول، ورد الدراهم الزائفة على ناقدها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد الإرجاع المكاني ولا دفع الضرر إلا مع معنى عدم القبول أو الإبطال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رد عليه الشيء إذا لم يقبله وكذلك إذا خطأه (sihah)؛ ردود الدراهم واحدها رد وهو ما زيف فرد على ناقده بعد ما أخذ منه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi bir malın geri verilmesini istemeyi veya onu geri almayı, ayrıca bozulan satışta iki tarafın aldıklarını karşılıklı vermesini açıkça kapsar. Dalın ticari ve karşılıklı sınırı kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, geri isteme ve satışın bozulmasında karşılıklı iade ile sınırlıdır; sıradan dönüş veya yeni bir satış işlemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca geri isteme, malı geri alma ve satış taraflarının karşılıklı iadesini bildiren yapılara uygulanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendisine geri verilmesini istemek veya verilmiş malı geri almak; bozulan bir satışta da tarafların aldıklarını birbirine geri vererek işlemi çözmesidir.

facets.statement: Önceden verilmiş ya da el değiştirmiş bir şey geri istenir veya geri alınır.
Satış bozulduğunda iki taraf da aldığı şeyi ötekine geri verir ve değişim tersine çevrilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, tek taraflı geri isteme ve geri alma ile satışın bozulmasındaki karşılıklı iadeyi aynı geri kazanma düzeninde birleştirir; ticari kullanımda her taraf eline geçeni geri verir.

concept_gloss.text: geri isteme veya karşılıklı geri verme

error_profile.preserves: Geri isteme, geri alma ve iki taraflı iade yoluyla işlemi çözme bileşenlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel geri dönüş, talep ya da satış ilişkisi gerektirmez; bu dal ise geri kazanma iradesi veya iki taraflı ticari çözme yapısına bağlıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه طلب رد الشيء واسترجاع المتاع، وتراد المتبايعين من الرد والفسخ
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل رجوع عام ما لم يظهر طلب الاسترجاع أو الفسخ أو المعاوضة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: استرده الشيء سأله أن يرده عليه وهما يترادان البيع من الرد والفسخ (sihah)؛ البيعان يترادان أي يرد كل واحد منهما ما أخذ واسترد المتاع استرجعه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi bu dalda Müslüman olduktan sonra inancı bırakıp inkâra dönmeyi açıkça belirtir. Bununla birlikte aynı türemiş biçimin din dışı geri dönüşlerde de kullanılabildiği ayrıca bildirildiği için dal kimliği yalnızca din ve inkâr açık olduğunda geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Özel adlandırma inkâra dönüşle sınırlıdır; genel geri dönüş anlamı ve başka tür din değişiklikleri kendiliğinden bu dala alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın olmayan adlar ve din bildiren yapı birlikte korunur; genel geri dönüş bildiren aynı biçim bu dinî dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İslam dinini benimsedikten sonra ondan ayrılıp inkâr durumuna dönmektir. Dal, bu eylemi ve onu gerçekleştiren kişiyi adlandıran dinle sınırlı biçimleri kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişi daha önce benimsediği İslam dininden ayrılarak inkâr durumuna döner.
Özel eylem adı yalnızca bu dinî inkâra dönüş için kullanılır.
Dönüş bildiren daha genel eylem adı başka alanlarda da geçebilir; burada ancak din açıkça belirtilirse bu dala bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, eylemi önceki inanç durumuna göre yön değiştirme olarak açıklar ve özel eylem adını inkâra dönüşe bağlar; daha genel dönüş adı ise bağlama göre din dışına taşabilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin Müslüman olduktan sonra dinini bırakıp inkâr durumuna geçtiğinin açıkça belirtildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki İslam bağlılığını, sonradan ayrılmayı ve inkâr durumuna geçişi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Önceki İslam bağlılığı bağlamdan biliniyor ve sonraki inkâr durumu vurgulanıyorsa kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi boşanmış ve ailesine geri gönderilmiş kadını temel adlandırma olarak verir; kızın yeniden babasının geçimine bağımlı olması da bu durumun açıklayıcı örneğidir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu katılımcı ve durum sınırını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu ad yalnızca boşanıp ailesine geri gönderilen kadını belirtir; her boşanmış kişi veya ailesine dönen her kadın kapsamda değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kanıtta ad olarak verilen boşanmış ve ailesine dönmüş kadın anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yapı bağımlı başka bir okuma eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Boşandıktan sonra ailesine, özellikle baba evine geri gönderilen kadındır. Başka geçim sağlayanı bulunmayan kızın yeniden babasının bakımına girmesi bunun açıklayıcı bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Kadın boşanmış ve eşinin yanından ailesine geri gönderilmiştir.
Ailesine dönüş, geçimini sağlayan başka bir kimse olmadığında yeniden baba bakımına girme sonucunu doğurabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım adlandırmayı boşanmış kadının ailesine geri gönderilmesine bağlar; yeniden babanın geçimine bağlı kalan kız örneği bu toplumsal ve ekonomik sonucu açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Boşanma sonrasında ailesine geri gönderilen kadın için kullanılır; geçim bağımlılığı yalnızca açıklayıcı örnek bağlamında eşlik edebilir.
